entities.name: Kloster Lorch
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Lorch Abbey was a Benedictine monastery in Lorch from 1102 to 1556 and again from 1630 to 1648. It was originally the house monastery of the Staufer dynasty. Today, many of its buildings remain and are open to visitors.
